responsibility: Declares and groups the Cranelift-specific optimization utilities used by rustc_codegen_cranelift during IR construction, exposing the optimization submodules that provide local simplification logic.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is only a lightweight namespace for Cranelift-specific optimization helpers, currently just exposing the `peephole` submodule. It does not itself perform ABI lowering, own debuginfo state, coordinate driver actions, or dispatch intrinsic codegen.
